text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A few days before the Tanabata Sho. Twin 
Turbo pushed herself in training to the 
point where her lungs felt ready to burst.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her front-running style had achieved its 
ultimate evolution. Proudly declaring her 
strategy beforehand, she pushed herself 
even further to the limit.
